messages:
Ana (CS): Heads-up — over the last hour we've seen ~13 onboarding tenants hit a partial activation flow failure. Activation emails sent but sample dataset indexing failed for some tenants, so customers see empty docs after signup. Not a full outage but high friction for first-time users.

Mike S.: Ack. Do we have a root cause yet?

Luis (Eng): Investigating. Initial signal points to a throttled background worker that handles indexing jobs + retry backoff misconfiguration. We also saw a spike in ingest payload size from one partner template that exacerbated queue depth.

Ana (CS): Thanks. Need to coordinate customer comms now — short status to affected tenants, offer credits, and schedule enablement sessions to rebuild trust. Can we draft an outbound note + a smaller technical blurb for high-touch accounts?

Julia P.: I can draft both. Quick Q: are we recommending immediate re-index for tenants or a manual data push?

Luis (Eng): Recommend a forced re-index with rate-limited workers. Ops can trigger a reprocess endpoint:

```
POST /internal/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/reindex
{ "mode": "rate_limited", "batch_size": 50 }
```

It'll queue jobs with safer defaults. We'll monitor queue length and errors.

Sara (Customer): FYI saw one of our trial tenants report this — they've already pinged CSM. Need the outbound note ASAP.

Ana (CS): Draft outbound for general affected group (trial & self-serve): short status + ETA + credit offer. Draft for high-touch (enterprise) adds technical appendix and invite to enablement call. Julia — can you post drafts here?

Julia P.: Posting drafts.

Julia P.: GENERAL NOTE DRAFT:
Hi — we're reaching out about an onboarding issue that affected a subset of new signups between 09:10–10:05 UTC. Activation emails were delivered but some sample data indexing didn't complete, so you may see empty or partial content in the product. We're sorry for the interruption.

- What we did: Identified a worker throttling misconfiguration and restarted the reindex pipeline.
- What we're doing now: Triggering a safe, rate-limited reindex for affected tenants; monitoring until successful.
- ETA: most tenants should see their sample data restored within 30–90 minutes.
- What you can do: No action required — we'll update when reindex completes. If you'd like immediate attention, reply to this thread and we'll prioritize.

As a token we applied a one-time $50 account credit for affected new signups. If this impacted a paid trial, your CSM will follow up with tailored compensation.

Thanks for your patience — Ana (Customer Success)

Julia P.: HIGH-TOUCH NOTE DRAFT (to send via CSM):
Hi <Name>,
We saw partial sample-data ingestion during onboarding for your trial between 09:10–10:05 UTC. We've identified the cause (background worker backpressure triggered by an unexpected payload spike) and are reprocessing your ingest with controlled rate limits.

Immediate actions:
- We're running a forced reindex now and monitoring tokens/latency.
- We've scheduled a 30-minute enablement session with your CSM to walk through the dataset and any custom templates.
- We're offering a targeted trial extension or credit — please let your CSM know which you prefer.

Technical appendix (for your engineering lead):
```
Root cause: worker queue backpressure + retry storm from oversized partner template
Mitigation: rate-limited reindex, patch to retry backoff, reject >1MB sample payloads pending template validation
Follow-up: deploy a worker config fix and guardrail by EOD
```

Please let us know a convenient time for the session.

Ana (CS): Good. Ops/Eng needs to confirm reindex trigger and monitoring. Mike — can you own the execution and sanity checks? I'll coordinate outbound sends and CSM outreach.

Mike S.: I can take execution. Plan: trigger reindex for the 13 tenants, run smoke checks (search results non-empty, sample doc count >= expected), and post status every 10 minutes in this thread.

deploy-bot: Reindex job queued for 13 tenants (job-4892). ETA estimates vary per tenant.

Luis (Eng): Patch ready for retry backoff config; will roll to staging then prod once reindex stabilizes. Patch notes: tighten backoff factor, add maximum retry window, instrument queue-depth alerts.

Ana (CS): Credit ask — recommend $50 for self-serve trials, for paid trials offer one-week extension or $200 credit for mid-market accounts. Thoughts?

Julia P.: Agree on $50 trial credit. For paid/mid-market, $200 or 1-week extension makes sense. Need sign-off from finance for anything >$500.

Mike S.: Reindex kicked — starting smoke checks.

Mike S.: Check 1/13: tenant-8 — sample docs restored, search OK.

Mike S.: Check 4/13: tenant-3 and tenant-7 still enqueueing, error rate reduced.

Ana (CS): CSMs — please prepare a short personalized note to your high-touch accounts offering the enablement slot + extension. Put replies into the shared doc: https://redwood.internal/cs/onboard-incident/3123456789 

Sara (Customer): Appreciate the quick response. Can you flag if an account shows retention/risk (trial conversion low) so we can prioritize outreach?

Ana (CS): Yes — we'll add renewal-risk flags to the shared tracker. Ask: @Luis (Eng) can you add a field in the job response payload with `estimated_restore_minutes` so CSMs can set expectations?

Luis (Eng): Will add estimated_restore_minutes to the job response within next 12m.

Mike S.: Check 12/13: all tenants restored. Running final verification now.

Mike S.: Final smoke: all 13 tenants show expected sample doc counts, no errors in the queue, 0.2% request errors in the 10–minute window.

Ana (CS): Excellent. Communications plan:
- Send GENERAL NOTE to all affected self-serve users now (Julia to publish).
- CSMs send HIGH-TOUCH notes + schedule enablement sessions (CS team).
- Apply credits per the agreed tiers.
- Post an incident summary + follow-up RCA in #postmortems tomorrow with timeline + permanent fix ETA.

Julia P.: General note posted. Link to sent email (internal): https://redwood.internal/cs/outbound/3123456789/email

Ana (CS): Thanks team. Can we capture feedback after enablement sessions? Add a 2-question pulse to the follow-up: 1) Did the session help you complete onboarding? 2) Any blockers remaining? CSMs add responses to the tracker.

Luis (Eng): I'll follow-up on the prod patch and confirm deployment window for the permanent fix (aiming EOD).

Mike S.: Marking this thread resolved for execution side — will keep monitoring but no further active ops steps.

Ana (CS): Closing loop — I'll publish a short customer-facing status update in 30m summarizing completion and credits applied. Thanks all :thumbsup:
